name: astar-erp-docs-tools
description: Rebuilds the documentation diagrams (docs/images) and Word files (docs/*.docx) from the Markdown sources.

scripts.docx: node md2docx.js ../PRD.md ../Astar-ERP-PRD.docx "Astar ERP — Product Requirements Document v1.0" && node md2docx.js ../TECHNICAL-DESIGN.md ../Astar-ERP-Technical-Design.docx "Astar ERP — Technical Design Document v1.0"
scripts.build: npm run diagrams && npm run docx
